title: (Patched!) Sub 10 Min Kuldra Skip Guide (Post-Patch 1.0.1) – Every Skip Explained | RS Dragonwilds
author: SamFPlays
chapters: (NEW) Skip the Garou thane area (thank you @Sir_Rebral) FAST
NEW) Elemental puzzle skip (thank you @IINo1goodII and @notmusty1
Where to stand so heartworms don't spawn & outro
description:
Every new Kuldra skip after Patch 1.0.1, explained step by step so you can pull them off yourself. Use the chapters to jump straight to the skip you need.

Watch the full run at speed, 2 of the skips in the 11 min run are slower (no commentary, 11 min): https://youtu.be/WpvNjqVmpVM

CHAPTERS
0:00 Phase Dash & Surge Combo
1:43 Gear & setup
2:13 First air anima
2:31 Soulscourge skip
3:10 Black dragon skip
3:28 SKIP the entire Necromancer area
4:20 Skip the entire poison area
5:00 Abby demon skip
5:37 (NEW) Skip the Garou thane area (thank you @Sir_Rebral) FAST
7:27 (NEW) Elemental puzzle skip (thank you @IINo1goodII and @notmusty1)
9:18 Skip the entire Kuldra fight
10:37 Where to stand so heartworms don't spawn & outro

GEAR & SETUP
- Fleet Foot Infusion: MUST BRING. Cuts sprinting stamina cost by 50%.
- Strong Tea: nice to have, restores +20 Rest.
- Melee weapon: Best mace you have
- Mage weapon: 2-handed mage staff for killing the heart at the end.
- Armour: best mage gear you have.

Which skip were you stuck on? Drop it in the comments. If this helped, a sub helps the channel a ton!

#Dragonwilds #RuneScape #Kuldra
